Three kinds of firm. The same problem underneath.

Skilled people spend their days moving data between documents and systems. We build the software that does the moving, so they can do the judging.

  • Commercial real estate

    Acquisitions, asset management, development, brokerage and syndication teams.

    Offering memoranda, rent rolls and T-12s go straight into your model. IC memos are drafted in your template from approved numbers. Investor onboarding and capital calls run without the spreadsheet relay.

    • OM, rent roll and T-12 extraction
    • Underwriting and IC memo drafts
